 Odisha govt hikes Dearness Allowance by 3% for state employees
 SECTIONS Odisha govt hikes Dearness Allowance by 3% for state employees PTI Last Updated: Nov 17, 2026, 02:22:00 PM IST Rate Story Follow us Share Font Size Abc Small Abc Medium Abc Large Save Print Comment Synopsis Odisha Chief Minister Mohan Charan Majhi announced a three percent hike in Dearness Allowance for government employees. The increase raises the DA from 60 percent to 63 percent, effective from July 1. Pensioners will also benefit from the same three percent increase in Dearness Relief. Approximately 8.5 lakh government employees and pensioners will receive this additional financial support. Payments reflecting the increased DA will be included in the November salary.
 Odisha Chief Minister Mohan Charan Majhi announced a three percent hike in Dearness Allowance for government employees Bhubaneswar: Odisha Chief Minister Mohan Charan Majhi on Tuesday announced a three per cent hike in Dearness Allowance (DA) for state government employees.
 The DA for government employees has now increased from 60 per cent to 63 per cent.
This will be effective retrospectively from July 1, and the increased DA will be paid in cash along with the salary for the month of November, a release issued by the Chief Minister's Office said. 
Additionally, the Dearness Relief for pensioners has also been increased by three per cent.
Around 8.5 lakh Odisha government employees and pensioners will benefit from the raise, officials said.
